title: Columbia Horse Center
specs: Camp includes riding twice daily, horsemanship education, crafts, and pizza party
Hunter/Jumper and Combined Training show series with prizes and ribbons
All riding levels welcome for camp

Riders under 18 must not be left unattended without prior consent

blurb: Guests participate in riding lessons tailored by age and skill, summer camps with riding twice daily and horsemanship education, and hunter/jumper or combined training horse shows. Camps include crafts, barn lessons, and a pizza party. Lessons require proper riding gear and are available in packages or single sessions.
